title: TestSpec
description: Test specification for all API functions. Produced before implementation. Source of truth for test authorship and independent verification. Version 1.0.0.

glId.description: Glossary term identifier. Format: GL-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

fnRef.description: Function ID from ApiSpec. Format: FN-camelCase, e.g. FN-createUser

testCategory.description: Which category of test this is.

reqId.description: Functional requirement identifier, format REQ-NNN. Must match an ID in GoalSpec.

nfrId.description: Non-functional requirement identifier, format NFR-NNN. Must match an ID in GoalSpec.

concreteValue.description: A concrete example value — string, number, boolean, object, or array. Must NOT be a placeholder like 'a valid userId' or 'some string'.

requirementsTestEntry.description: Maps a requirement to the test cases that verify it. Useful for REQ→test traceability.

reqRef.description: The requirement ID this entry covers (REQ-NNN or NFR-NNN).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this requirement tests.

testIds.description: Test case IDs that verify this requirement.

glossaryRefItem.description: A text item with inline glossary references.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in this item.

version.description: Semver version of this test document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the TestSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '1.0.0'.

project.description: Must match project name across all other specs.

apiSpecVersion.description: Version of the ApiSpec this test spec was authored against.

dataSpecVersion.description: Version of the DataSpec used for type resolution.

verificationStatus.description: Whether the independent clean-context verification step has been performed.

functionCoverage.description: Per-function coverage summary. One entry per function in ApiSpec. Used for completeness assessment.

outOfScope.description: Explicit list of behaviours this function's tests do NOT verify. Required — prevents false failures during verification.

requirementsTests.description: Maps each requirement to the test cases that verify it. Optional — useful for REQ→test traceability. Use the generate_tests tool to populate automatically.

tests.description: All test cases across all functions.

fnRef.description: The function this test exercises. Must match a function ID in ApiSpec.

description.description: The scenario being tested in plain language.

input.description: Concrete input values keyed by parameter name. Every required parameter from ApiSpec must be present. Values must be concrete — no placeholders.

expectedOutput.description: The exact expected return value or shape. Required for happy-path and edge-case tests.

expectedOutputType.description: The type name of the expected output, for cross-spec validation against DataSpec.

contractClause.description: Which part of the ApiSpec contract this test verifies. Quote or paraphrase the relevant clause.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs this test verifies. Include when the test directly validates a requirement. Omit for technical tests (error paths, edge cases, infrastructure).

errorCode.description: Required for error-path tests. Must match an error code documented on this function in ApiSpec.

expectedError.description: For error-path tests: what the caller receives.

messageContains.description: Optional substring the error message must contain.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this test case.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in this test's description and contractClause.
